notes.title: Update Preview for the Second Stage~~
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, this is Zyf. ːsteamhappyː
The goals of the previous stage have been successfully achieved~~ 
It has been ten days since the release of the demo, and there has been a constant stream of people coming forward with suggestions, bug reports, and requests. 
I hope I haven't missed any of them. These have been extremely helpful to me, and I welcome more feedback in the future!

Now let me give you a report on what has been accomplished during this period:
[olist]
[*] The main forces of the Bug Legion have been eliminated.
[*] New vehicles have been added: Cruiser Mk I, Churchill, Hellcat, and Tiger II.
[*] The functionality to sell and sort turrets has been added.
[*] A settings interface has been added.
[*] Slightly improved gameplay experience.
[/olist]
The above is just the first step of a long journey. I know that the current version is far from qualifying as a DEMO version. However, I already know what I should do next:
[h2]1. Advanced Difficulty[/h2] I have noticed that some players have already started engaging in challenges and speedruns. It's apparently that current difficulty is not enough to satisfy our skilled tank commanders. More difficulties will be arranged soon!
[h2]2. Upgrades Outside of Battles[/h2] The system to train squad leaders will be introduced soon! You will be able to train a student from multiple directions to become a squad leader, and she will change the entire combat style afterwards.
[h2]3. Content Expansion[/h2] I will be adding at least three new vehicles every week, not to mention new skills, hull upgrades, and events. As for new maps and objectives, I will see what I can do.

Thank you, my friends! 😆

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44089194/3edb59bed3acfe9a5204bc4561192d728b7fe50e.png[/img]

notes.title: Future Update Preview~~
notes.notes:
The number of players who have been playing these past few days has been tremendous, and they have provided valuable feedback. I am truly grateful! 😄
Next, I will focus on fixing some of the widely mentioned issues as soon as possible:

[olist]
[*] Fixing bugs, such as the problem where players sometimes cannot revive after death.
[*] Adding the ability to sell and rearrange turrets.
[*] Adding a settings interface for adjusting window size and volume.
[*] Some players feel that the levels are too short and end too quickly. I will adjust the pacing of the levels based on the feedback received in the past two days, primarily by reducing Non-combat time, extending overall battle duration, and increasing player decision-making opportunities.
[/olist]
There will be frequent updates coming up, so those who are interested can keep an eye out daily. Thank you, my friends! 😆
